bio: Giacomo Barbarigo's journey from facchino at the Rialto docks to esteemed art merchant exemplifies the rare social mobility possible in La Serenissima through commerce and cunning. His exceptional eye for quality, refined during years of handling delicate cargo, has transformed into an almost preternatural talent for appraising artistic works at Venice's prestigious Art Gallery.
